owner_approval: 2026-09-07: owner approved scene-matched Town layers and resuming full-match quality.

generation.references: Original Veilmourn village panorama, original catalog icons and accepted original scene-layer masters; exact inputs are described in each hash-locked prompt. No copyrighted game references.

processing: Crop only fully transparent outer margins, preserve generated alpha and aspect, Lanczos downsample to maximum 512px, strip derivative metadata for reproducible bytes; no drawn geometry, recoloring, background replacement or generated panorama substitution.
rights: Original project-generated art. No copied game pixels, names, protected symbols or third-party source assets.
catalog_icons: Unchanged; these exact-faction scene layers are not shared catalog replacements.
migration_scope: All non-embedded building identities in Veilmourn (27), Embercourt (30), Mireclaw (31) and Sunvault (29) have accepted exact scene layers. The Thornwake whole-faction batch adds 29 distinct original paintings across five towns, with combined visual/input/save/platform evidence recorded in the art-repair report. Preserve all 117 earlier rows, original villages, embedded Town Halls and separate catalog icons. Brasshollow's 27 mappings and broader visual acceptance remain unfinished. Exact provenance is per row; acceptance, fixture-versus-earned controls and platform limits are recorded in docs/generated-full-match-art-repair-report.md.
